name: Itsuwari no Alice -Retold Tale-
source:
"If you kill the impostors, you can become real —"

This is the trash can where the failed fragments of fairy tales are cast away. The failures have a name for themselves, "Alters", and fight to become real.

When you awaken, you encounter three false Alices: the Destroyer, the Hunter, and the Sorcerer. Each possesses her own unique personality, and must kill the others.

"Only one can become the true Alice."

To become the one true Alice, the failures continue their ritual of slaughter within this trash can world.

Suddenly, an anomaly slips in. You.

You begin to rewrite the tale, creating a story where death does not reign. In a world built upon mutual killing, this is the greatest taboo—and the only hope.

Who will you save, who will you choose?

Your decisions will shape the ending of this tale.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4013270/The_False_Alice_Retold_Tale/]Steam[/url]]

A visual novel based on the Itsuwari no Alice mobile game that originally launched in October 2019, but stopped receiving updates after July 2023. However, the game received a new update in 2026.
translation:
“如果你杀了冒名顶替者，你就能变得真实——”

这是一个垃圾桶，里面扔掉了失败的童话片段。这些失败者给自己起了一个名字，“改变者”，并为成为现实而奋斗。

当你醒来时，你会遇到三个假爱丽丝：毁灭者、猎人和魔法师。每个人都有自己独特的个性，必须杀死其他人。

“只有一个人才能成为真正的爱丽丝。”

为了成为真正的爱丽丝，失败者们在这个垃圾桶世界里继续着他们的屠杀仪式。

突然，一个异常现象出现了。你。

你开始重写这个故事，创造一个死亡不再统治的故事。在一个建立在互相残杀基础上的世界里，这是最大的禁忌，也是唯一的希望。

你要拯救谁，你会选择谁？

你的决定将决定这个故事的结局。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4013270/The_False_Alice_Retold_Tale/]Steam[/url]]

基于《五割之爱丽丝》手游的视觉小说，最初于2019年10月推出，但在2023年7月后停止接收更新。不过，该游戏于2026年收到了新的更新。
